table_locator: Table 2 p625, 37 observations at exactly 1873 and 2023 K, manually transcribed and visually rechecked
standard_basis: Both solutes use Henry mass percent in dilute pure liquid Fe; MgO(cr) activity is one in the MgO crucible experiment.
oxygen_self_interaction: e_O^O=-1750/T+0.76 from Sakao1959; Itoh cites the JSPS recommended value and tabulates -0.17 at 1873 K.
concentration_note: Table headings are (mass %) x 10^4: divide the transcribed columns by 10000 to recover mass percent. Row23 Mg=0.7, visually checked. No rectangle between extrema is empirically established.
pressure_note: Ar laboratory gas and MgO crucible; no high-pressure response or exact pressure uncertainty is calibrated.

JANAF.columns: S and H-H(Tr); absolute G on fixed 298.15K elemental enthalpy gauge, not the temperature-dependent formation G column.

uncertainty_policy: No fit covariance or statistical transfer bound; reported residuals are descriptive. No unlimited high-O/Si/H extrapolation is adopted.
